command: async page => { const links=await page.locator(".model-profile-technical a").evaluateAll(xs=>xs.map(a=>({text:a.textContent,href:a.href}))); const checks=[];for(const link of links){if(new URL(link.href).origin===new URL(page.url()).origin){const r=await page.request.get(link.href);checks.push({...link,status:r.status()});}}return {open:await page.locator(".model-profile-technical").evaluate(d=>d.open),links,checks}; }
